confirm.type_email: Type your account's email address to confirm. Nothing is deleted until you click Delete my account.

explain: Your user profile, your settings and all workspaces where you are the owner are deleted for good.
The subscriptions of the workspaces you own are cancelled at once.
Workspaces you belong to but do not own are kept. You are removed from them, and their owners keep their data.
